svg.title: Gizmo: Rebuilt
svg.desc: Fidget the Gremlin and two others scuttle in and surround Gizmo, cackling. Each one pinches thin and pops back out as a stubby blaster with its own eyes on it. Fidget fires first and clips the very tip off his lower end. Then all three fire in turn, kicking back with each shot, and he jerks and buckles with every hit until he bursts into blocks and drops in a heap. The blasters pop back into Gremlins, cackle, and leave. One eye in the heap blinks twice and closes. A scan bar sweeps down, broken scan lines trace his outline standing again, and he resolves whole, tip included. His eyes load one at a time and a visor drops over them. He looks left and right in hard steps. Fidget peeks back in, the visor locks onto it, he advances two stiff steps, and Fidget bolts. The visor lifts and he returns to neutral. Ten second loop on a transparent background.
